findings.message: Codex review of TASK-058 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Persistence resilience implementation is complete with high scenario fidelity.

Deterministic persistence resilience runner validates all key persistence behaviors: autosave cadence at 30-second intervals, non-blocking behavior during active edit, event-log replay across restart, and safe snapshot reload.
Machine-readable output via PERSISTENCE_RESILIENCE_REPORT_JSON enables automated CI processing, reporting, and integration with monitoring systems.
CI runner script properly integrated into quality gates, ensuring persistence resilience is validated as part of standard pre-merge and pre-release checks.

All validation passes: run-persistence-resilience.sh (exit 0) and run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0). Scenario fidelity confirmed for all persistence operations including autosave, active-edit, restart/reload, and snapshot reload.
Scenario coverage is comprehensive: autosave cadence, active-edit non-blocking, restart/reload event-log replay, safe snapshot reload. All acceptance criteria fully addressed.

Future enhancement noted: corruption/failure-injection cases identified as potential addition but not blocking current approval. Current implementation provides solid foundation for persistence validation.
Documentation updated: README.md references new persistence resilience suite, backlog.yaml updated to reflect TASK-058 implementation.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-058 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Persistence resilience runner with machine-readable output is fully operational and integrated into CI. All acceptance criteria are met: autosave cadence verified, non-blocking behavior confirmed, restart/reload consistency validated, results emitted in machine-readable form. Scenario fidelity confirmed. Corruption/failure-injection cases noted as future enhancement. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
